text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! I managed to run all the 
way to the finish in my debut race~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh, yes!! Thank you so much...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My head is still spinning, so it hasn't 
really sunk in yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, this means our serious challenge 
for the Twinkle Series is finally 
beginning...!

Having safely cleared her Debut, Special 
Week returned to the academy. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that our initial goal, the debut race, 
is over... it's time to decide what we 
should aim for next, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then I...! There's a race I've always 
wanted to run in!
choice_data_list: A race you wanted to run in?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once in a lifetime... A race only 
Classic-tier Umamusume can run in, 
deciding the strongest of their 
generation...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I... I want to run in the Japan 
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm aiming to be the best in Japan, 
I definitely want to claim the title of 
"Derby Umamusume"!

True, if you're claiming to be the best in 
Japan, that's not a race you can afford to 
overlook.

"Besides, the name of the Derby Umamusume 
will surely echo all the way to distant 
Hokkaido, where her mother is...!"
choice_data_list:
Alright, our next goal is the Japanese 
Derby!

Alright, our next goal is the Japanese 
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Yes!!

"...That being said, given her current 
level of experience, she isn't quite ready 
to jump straight into the Derby."

"Before that, we should enter a slightly 
bigger race to build up some experience. 
So—"
choice_data_list: First, we're entering the Kisaragi Sho!
First, let's enter the Kisaragi Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a GIII...!! A graded race... I-I'm 
getting nervous...
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll be a good experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Experience... that makes sense. If our 
goal is the Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll get a solid feel for 
racing at the Kisaragi Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, aiming for the main goal—the 
Derby— I'm gonna give it my all!
